spin_360.notes: Levoit product page has no 360 viewer (only CSS loading-spinner classes). Amazon current Core 300S-P listing (B0G19ZCNP9) image data contains 18 flat gallery images and zero spin/360 entries; the 'ImageBlockImmersiveView360' string on the page is a generic feature-name list, not active spin data.

collection_gaps: No separate quick-start guide PDF is published for the US Core 300S; the user manual serves as the setup guide (levoit.com user-manuals page lists only the full manual; Wayback CDX shows no 300S QSG on the Levoit CDN).

No official photo of the bottom filter compartment with the cover twisted open; closest official images are the filter-beside-unit shot and the manual's line diagrams (see manuals/). The VeSync app video (src_video_vesync_app_flow) shows the replacement flow as an illustration.
No true rear/back or straight side official photo published (product is cylindrical and near-rotationally symmetric, so front/three-quarter/top coverage is effectively complete).
No Core 300S-specific video found on the official Levoit or VeSync YouTube channels; only third-party how-to videos exist on YouTube (excluded).
support.levoit.com help center requires login (Salesforce 401/redirect); its articles could not be captured.

The 3000x3000 PNGs (front, top panel, elevated three-quarter) were recovered via Wayback Machine snapshots of official levoit.com CDN URLs because Levoit removed the originals when the 300S page was replaced by the 300S-P page; provenance remains manufacturer but retrieval path is archive.org.

Regulatory/label model number (LAP-C301S-xxx style) could not be confirmed from an official US source; official spec table states Model: 'Core 300S' and the manuals are CID-encoded PDFs whose text could not be extracted programmatically.
